method: Each case began in a clean detached Git worktree. The applied diff was read and recorded, restored, then applied identically and verified before executing the named Node test. A recorded red requires a failing assertion in the expected test; process and syntax failures alone cannot count. All restored source/test bytes below match the reachable commits. Full focused suites were green before and after each lane. Marketing uses actual registry audit responses and the full 626-package lock.
